basis: Dine Brands’ March 1 earnings release was the earliest qualifying communication found. Its consolidated GAAP table reports Q4 FY2022 total revenue of $207,965,000 against $229,630,000 in Q4 FY2021. Revenue fell 9.43%, putting it $10,183,500 below the $218,148,500 threshold. The earlier guidance reviewed gave no upper bound for consolidated Q4 revenue.

coverage.detail: August 9, 2022, Q2 release. Dine reaffirmed fiscal 2022 guidance, including $235 million to $250 million of adjusted EBITDA. Its sales comparisons concerned brand-level restaurant performance. The release gave no Q4 consolidated revenue forecast.
August 9 management call. The CFO reaffirmed full-year guidance. The call supplied no numeric upper bound for Q4 consolidated revenue.

November 2, 2022, Q3 release. Dine reported nine-month revenue of $701,437,000 and narrowed fiscal 2022 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $243 million to $248 million, reflecting Q4 spending and refranchising. It gave neither a Q4 nor a full-year consolidated revenue range from which to calculate a revenue ceiling.

November 2 management call. In Q&A, the CFO described the full-year guidance as effectively guiding Q4. The exchange addressed EBITDA, G&A spending and the effect of refranchising. Management gave no consolidated Q4 revenue amount or percentage decline.
December 2. The Q4 announcement declared a $0.51-per-share dividend and contained no revenue update.
December 5. Dine announced an $80 million agreement to acquire Fuzzy’s Taco Shop and expected immediate earnings accretion. It gave no Q4 consolidated revenue guidance.
December 5 investor presentation. The roughly $230 million sales estimate covered Fuzzy’s 2022 systemwide restaurant sales. It did not establish Dine’s reported quarterly revenue.
January 4, 2023. The executive leadership announcement discussed Applebee’s sales qualitatively and gave no Q4 consolidated figure.
February 3, filed February 6. The Item 2.02 amendment corrected the September 30 leverage ratio from 3.90x to 4.29x. It contained no preliminary Q4 revenue.
February 15. Dine’s Business Wire notice scheduled the Q4 and fiscal 2022 earnings announcement for March 1 and supplied no preliminary revenue.
February 21. Dine announced a $0.51-per-share Q1 2023 dividend and gave no Q4 revenue update.

March 1. The issuer’s Q4 release attributes the revenue decline primarily to the October sale of 69 company-operated Applebee’s restaurants. The consolidated table retains company restaurant sales of $9,694,000 in Q4 FY2022 and $36,582,000 in Q4 FY2021, reflecting the ownership in each period. As a cross-check, fiscal 2022 actual revenue of $909,402,000 less nine-month actual revenue of $701,437,000 equals the directly reported $207,965,000.

The 10-K confirms that Dine acquired Fuzzy’s on December 13, 2022. Dine labels its year-end December 31 for reporting convenience. FY2022 actually ended January 1, 2023, and FY2021 ended January 2, 2022. Both were 52-week years.

publication_date_evidence: Dine’s investor-relations release displays March 1, 2023, and carries a same-day Business Wire dateline announcing Q4 and fiscal 2022 results. SEC Exhibit 99.1 reproduces the dated release and its quarterly consolidated revenue table.
